reply.summary: Eornian is a blustering corner enforcer who swings a length of chain and talks bigger than he fights. Eornian keeps a crew loyal because he never walks away from a dare, however foolish.

feats.scene: Eornian whips his chain across a parked van and snaps the wing mirror clean off.
Eornian takes a thrown bottle on the skull and keeps laughing.

reply.summary: Celros is a soft-spoken, bald interrogator who works with a roll of polished dental picks and a patient smile. Celros is married, devoted to a quiet family life, and treats each confession as a tidy appointment.

feats.scene: Celros drives a steel pick through a heavy oak chair arm to pin a prisoner in place.
Celros shrugs off a cudgel blow across the ribs and finishes his sentence.

reply.summary: Tianan is a former star athlete who became the channel for a field of stillness that bends time. Tianan clung to a lost season so hard that a whole town looped back to an old year, and dinosaurs and legionaries wandered its streets until the loop was undone.

feats.scene: Tianan drags an entire town and its surroundings back twenty years and holds the loop in place for days.
Tianan stands inside the time bubble as it expands, unmarked by the stresses that tear nearby walls.

reply.summary: Testti is a mid-ranking bureaucrat in a police state, in charge of a secretive investigations branch. Testti has no special gifts, only a loaded sense of duty, and rushes out to head off a killer with a pistol that turns out to be empty.

feats.scene: Testti swings an empty pistol at an intruder's jaw in a panicked last stand.
Testti stumbles against a stone doorframe at full run and stays on his feet.

reply.summary: Teelacor is a harried clerk who sorts the dead into the next stage of their journey. Teelacor drowns in paperwork, wears a strange blotchy rash, and is permanently deathless, which makes every misfiled soul a recurring headache.

feats.scene: Teelacor stamps a decree that sends a roaring soul down a corridor of collapsing archways.
Teelacor endures the full backlash of a failed reincarnation ritual without losing his place in the queue.

reply.summary: Iumreco is a hired killer whose body was dissolved and rebuilt by a storm of chemical waste. Iumreco now eats through anything he touches and lives in constant agony, which he describes to every victim in loving detail.

feats.scene: Iumreco grips a steel vault door and burns a man-sized hole through it in under a minute.
Iumreco walks out of a blast that wrecks the processing tank around him.

reply.summary: Receste is a disgraced industrialist whose lab accident left him glowing with deadly radiation. Receste hunts a young masked rival through the city and once used a haunted clockwork heart to slip backwards through time.

feats.scene: Receste bleeds a pulse of radiation that cooks a whole warehouse floor and everything on it.
Receste sits in the heart of a collapsing reactor core and strolls out unhurt.

reply.summary: Sesntrn is a huge, one-eyed hybrid of a worn-out social outcast and a police robot that gained a conscience. Sesntrn fights for the poor in a divided future, and its steel arms hit with far more than any human could manage.

feats.scene: Sesntrn punches a loading crane's support leg until the whole frame buckles.
Sesntrn stands in the path of a runaway freight carrier and stops it with his chest.

reply.summary: Tetaci is a cheerful teacher who runs a student club for building small machines. Tetaci grew up tinkering beside a close friend, lost touch with him for years, and still believes every old bond can be mended.

feats.scene: Tetaci hurls a heavy toolbox across the workshop and clears a jammed door.
Tetaci falls from a stepladder onto a concrete floor and gets back up grinning.

reply.summary: Tiamcil is an ageless sorceress who lost her youth to a shadow creature and retreated into scheming. Tiamcil shaped a living champion out of clay and spellwork, hoping to put her on a throne, and once ran faster than any of her sisters.

feats.scene: Tiamcil pours borrowed witchcraft into a clay form and wakes a warrior in a single storm of green light.
Tiamcil is thrown against a marble pillar and rises slowly, leaning on a cane.

reply.summary: Sercol is a restless mercenary who moves so fast she smears into a blur. Sercol can spin that speed into a small whirlwind and has jumped between more than one crew without ever quite settling.

feats.scene: Sercol spins in place and flings a rooftop's gravel and glass across the next street.
Sercol crosses a courtyard in a single heartbeat, leaving her pursuers grabbing air.

reply.summary: Arnin is a pale, cunning god-scientist who builds cruel devices for a distant tyrant. Arnin cannot die, tears through armour when he must, and draws up new experiments the way other people hum.

feats.scene: Arnin switches on a fuel-fed engine that levels a fortified quarter of a city.
Arnin walks out of the wreck of his own laboratory with only soot on his sleeves.

reply.summary: Leslleso is a fawning torturer-god who serves a dying master. Leslleso opens a doorway through space to fling a victim home, a desperate act that only speeds the collapse of everything around him.

feats.scene: Leslleso tears a rift open across a firestorm and hurls a prisoner through it.
Leslleso stands at the edge of a furnace as it erupts and comes away singed.

reply.summary: Vineo is a small, blocky villain made of plastic bricks, sulking in a toy-box conflict. Vineo plots absurdly, assembles clumsy traps, and is rebuilt as good as new after every defeat.

feats.scene: Vineo clicks together a catapult of bricks and launches a stack of crates across the room.
Vineo is stomped flat by a giant boot and snaps back together piece by piece.

reply.summary: Suanu is a deathless god of pain who grows stronger from the suffering around him. Suanu bends minds, wears whatever face suits him, and once tried to harvest the blood of a captive in order to breed stronger soldiers.

feats.scene: Suanu rips a bridge from its piers and hurls it into a squad of invaders.
Suanu is struck by a collapsing tower and sits up amused.

reply.summary: Seerirn is a thin, blue-eyed aide who carries out the tasks his master considers beneath him. Seerirn works in a smouldering hellscape and spends more time arranging cruel chores than doing them himself.

feats.scene: Seerirn hurls a bolt of foul fire that collapses a fortified gateway.
Seerirn is knocked through a wall of slag and straightens his collar.

reply.summary: Llontite is a sun-baked bandit chief who preys on caravans from a crumbling stone fort. Llontite rides propeller sleds across the dunes and carries a device that chokes the engines of passing aircraft.

feats.scene: Llontite fires his engine-killing device and brings a fighter plane down in a dune.
Llontite is flung from a sled at speed and rolls to his feet in the sand.

reply.summary: Olucol is a masked planner who locked himself in a room for a year to out-think a famous detective. Olucol designs crimes in layers of cunning, and every failure only makes his next scheme more elaborate.

feats.scene: Olucol drops a trapdoor-laden vault floor through three storeys onto a pursuing guard.
Olucol takes a beating in an alley and calmly mutters the next step of his plan.

reply.summary: Tesvar is the shifting, glittering embodiment of longing, who lives inside a vast living statue made of flesh. Tesvar changes shape and temper at will, toys with mortals, and has sparred with a sibling over whose realm matters more.

feats.scene: Tesvar bends the wanting of countless worlds at once and tips an entire empire into ruin.
Tesvar sits unmoved while a rival realm's dreams crash against the walls of the statue.

reply.summary: Valan is a golden-eyed manipulator who treats every living wish as a toy. Valan drifts across the borders between worlds, wears whatever face convinces, and schemes to prove that dreams are just echoes of hunger.

feats.scene: Valan unmakes a kingdom's fortunes in one night and leaves its crowned heads begging for scraps.
Valan stands as an angry sibling hurls a storm of nightmares and does not blink.

reply.summary: Sortaor is a red-haired nightclub owner who stole a priceless statue to honour her grandmother's faded fame. Sortaor shot her partner during a screening and was caught soon after.

feats.scene: Sortaor fires a pistol at close range in a darkened cinema.
Sortaor tumbles down a short flight of velvet stairs and keeps running.

reply.summary: Tercoser is a patient fighting teacher who took in an orphaned girl and passed on everything he knew. Tercoser kept training until illness finally stopped him.

feats.scene: Tercoser snaps a strike through a stack of roof tiles in a quiet dojo.
Tercoser takes a sparring student's full kick to the ribs and merely nods.

reply.summary: Nucotiu is a vain former athlete who hid behind a grotesque mask after an injury ruined his looks. Nucotiu kidnapped handsome strangers, twisted them into attractions, and tried to disfigure a former sweetheart.

feats.scene: Nucotiu strikes a chain through a carnival turnstile and drags a bound hostage along.
Nucotiu tackles a guard head-on and shrugs off the answering blows.

reply.summary: Nortalmi is a tough alien warrior with pink tendrils for hair and a fearsome lasso. Nortalmi shares a deadly bloodline, shrugs off wounds, and met her end at the hands of a wave of visitors.

feats.scene: Nortalmi swings her lasso and slams a tower block's top floors into the street.
Nortalmi catches a falling girder with her shoulder and keeps advancing.

reply.summary: Vaurian is a towering, blue-skinned gunslinger who embodies a vanished way of life. Vaurian rides a pale horse through modern traffic and was finally ended by a lorry on a highway.

feats.scene: Vaurian fires a revolver and shatters a bottle on a distant fence post.
Vaurian is struck by a speeding lorry and drifts away like dust in the wind.

reply.summary: Silcor is a red-haired tyrant from a doomed possible future who was banished from his home world and travelled back in time. Silcor draws on a distant eternal flame, threatens a runner with a countdown, and presses hard for a world to be saved.

feats.scene: Silcor hurls a burst of flame-borne force that levels a mountainside.
Silcor is hammered by a team of allies and keeps pressing forward.

reply.summary: Lororeveo is a scarlet-skinned, black-eyed criminal who reads minds and lashes out with bursts of force. Lororeveo schemed to seize three charmed relics, but walked into the very trap he set for his hosts.

feats.scene: Lororeveo hurls a surge of psychic force that shears the top off a satellite dish array.
Lororeveo is pinned by a security field and strains against it for hours.

reply.summary: Lloretir is a yellow-eyed warlord seized by rival space police and flung down to a planet for show. Lloretir was meant to look like a menace to be rescued from, but a ring-wielding captor broke his neck.

feats.scene: Lloretir smashes through a fleet's hull plates and tumbles onto a stretch of desert.
Lloretir crashes through the atmosphere in chains and lands alive.

reply.summary: Llatis is an eight-foot alien despot whose ancestors were mutated by a poisoned planet. Llatis once ruled through mind control and games of strategy, then became a furious bruiser consumed by hatred.

feats.scene: Llatis flattens a ridge of mountains with a single driving blow.
Llatis takes a volley of heavy cannon fire and strides through the smoke.

reply.summary: Storisi is a hulking alien conqueror with a taste for planet-plundering and a telepathic punch. Storisi attacked an orbital station with a ring of poison rock and was sent into a coma by a stronger mind.

feats.scene: Storisi tears through a space station's outer shell and floods its halls with psychic noise.
Storisi weathers a full-strength mind blast for several seconds before collapsing.

reply.summary: Liuserora is a hulking alien brute who joined a mob of villains chasing two famous heroes. Liuserora brings raw weight and little subtlety, and mostly gets in the way of the other hunters.

feats.scene: Liuserora tears the roof off a speeding train and hurls it into a hillside.
Liuserora is slammed into a bridge pier and rises, dusty and sour.

reply.summary: Nalaun is a senior warrior of an island sisterhood with a long record of command. Nalaun trains younger fighters at dawn, holds the line at the harbour wall, and trusts her spear above all else.

feats.scene: Nalaun hurls a spear clean through a heavy oak shield.
Nalaun is thrown down a stone stair by a charging boar and rises unbroken.

reply.summary: Amotirso is an ancient sorcerer who feeds on terror and cloaks himself in a shield that drives touchers mad. Amotirso flies, burns, and hops into a fresh body whenever his own is destroyed.

feats.scene: Amotirso hurls a ball of flame that burns a chapel to its footings.
Amotirso stands in the middle of a detonating tower and his shield holds.

reply.summary: Nerni is the blind, calm keeper of every event that has been or will be, who walks a maze of branching paths forever. Nerni casts no shadow, leaves no footprints, and carries a heavy chained book at his wrist.

feats.scene: Nerni turns a page and a whole sequence of possible histories folds out of existence.
Nerni walks on through a collapsing lattice of timelines without breaking his stride.

reply.summary: Telil is a shabby, wandering tramp who is yanked by sudden trances to places where killings are about to happen. Telil breaks up thugs with a few judo throws and vanishes before anyone can thank him.

feats.scene: Telil throws a gunman over his hip into a stack of barrels.
Telil takes a cosh across the shoulder and answers with a calm word.

reply.summary: Anvaan is a red-eyed, hairless bruiser who appears in the shadow of a young hero team's quarrels. Anvaan says little, hits hard, and is seen mostly at the edge of a brawl.

feats.scene: Anvaan slams a fist into a car door and crumples it inward.
Anvaan is hit by a thrown dumpster and merely rolls his shoulders.

reply.summary: Iucorca is a minor illusionist who joined a gang of villains to take on a famous hero. Iucorca could make convincing shapes, but never enough force behind them, and left with her allies for the stars.

feats.scene: Iucorca conjures a roaring beast of light that shoves a guard backwards into a door.
Iucorca is thrown across a rooftop and rolls to her feet, wheezing.

reply.summary: Tanlluma is a blond card-themed thug who fights under a suit marking in a gang of masked robbers. Tanlluma lost an eye along the way and died in a showdown that spread across the whole villain network.

feats.scene: Tanlluma hurls a steel-edged playing card through a plasterboard wall.
Tanlluma takes a rifle butt to the face and keeps coming.

reply.summary: Iacormil is a brown-eyed footsoldier from a fallen warrior caste who was locked away for a coup attempt. Iacormil served a hard commander, fought alongside him on a conquered world, and was sent back into the prison zone.

feats.scene: Iacormil smashes through a wall of reinforced concrete in a single charge.
Iacormil stands unharmed under a tumbling slab of masonry.

reply.summary: Anlia is a white-haired scientist and council member in a city shrunk to a bottle's size. Anlia uses a wheelchair, keeps a hidden cave stocked with costumes and vehicles, and helped a friend win back a stolen daughter.

feats.scene: Anlia heaves a heavy lever to open the hidden cave's rock door.
Anlia is jolted in his chair by a falling beam and carries on.

reply.summary: Ontseoci is a small red-haired weapon moulded from clay and blessed with dark gifts by a tyrant's children. Ontseoci was made to mirror a famous champion and match her in battle, though she is only a few feet tall.

feats.scene: Ontseoci smashes a temple colonnade into rubble with a single backhand.
Ontseoci is slammed into a cliff face and leaves a crater when she gets up.

reply.summary: Narotu is a red-eyed demigoddess created to kill a famous warrior and now serving a war leader. Narotu is hard to kill with age, fights with a long sword, and works from a bunker in a cold northern land.

feats.scene: Narotu cleaves through a steel bulkhead with a long, flat sweep of her sword.
Narotu is crushed under a falling gantry and rises unmarked.

reply.summary: Senumnum is a bruised border-town crook who tattooed a famous nickname on his back. Senumnum scrapped with a rival over the title, got arrested, then teamed up with him in a small gang.

feats.scene: Senumnum swings a crowbar into a rival's shoulder in a parking lot.
Senumnum takes a stool to the back and keeps swinging.

reply.summary: Elmiati is a friendly amphibious sea creature of high intelligence and blue eyes. Elmiati keeps to the open water, surfaces to help swimmers in trouble, and is shy of anyone who stares.

feats.scene: Elmiati drives a bow wave that flips a small fishing boat upright.
Elmiati is dragged across a reef by a rolling current and swims off unhurt.

reply.summary: Estnanla is a red-skinned, stone-fisted hero from a parallel reality who fought in a doomed last stand. Estnanla looks to be a loving homage to a famous occult investigator and lands blows like a falling anvil.

feats.scene: Estnanla smashes his stone fist into a monster's chest and shatters its ribcage.
Estnanla is hurled through a brick wall and wipes the dust off his shoulders.

reply.summary: Tirnoron is a brown-haired commander of an armoured security squad. Tirnoron bickers with a band of rival mercenaries, and is guilty of at least one killing.

feats.scene: Tirnoron drives a heavy gauntlet into a rival's breastplate.
Tirnoron takes a full burst of rifle fire against his armour and holds position.

reply.summary: Iumnate is a pale conqueror whose own people fused him to a star-powered suit and watched it turn on them. Iumnate drifted from world to world on the energy of dying suns, built a vast fleet, and fought a rival who nearly matched him.

feats.scene: Iumnate unleashes a pulse of stellar fire that cracks a moon-sized crust.
Iumnate trades blows with an equal and walks away with only dents in his armour.

reply.summary: Norvaam is a young team member who eats metal and grows it into a reshaping exoskeleton. Norvaam shapes eaten scrap into fast machine limbs, shoots bolts of current, heals, and jumps between places.

feats.scene: Norvaam swallows a car engine and punches a hole through a concrete pillar.
Norvaam takes a heavy cannon round into his plated chest and regrows the dent.

reply.summary: Amanu is a blue-furred housecat with yellow eyes and a ring that burns with fury. Amanu flies on streams of red light, fires bursts of energy, and teleports to his target when he hunts.

feats.scene: Amanu roars out a red burst that melts a bridge's steel to slag.
Amanu is hit by a heavy cannon and shakes it off with a flick of his tail.

reply.summary: Leonustel is a small housecat who watched his owner die and was swept up by a wrathful ring. Leonustel flies home, mourns by her side, and speaks in short, chilling sentences of vengeance.

feats.scene: Leonustel hurls a burst of crimson fire that collapses a riverside warehouse.
Leonustel is knocked across a rooftop by a thug's swing and bounds back up.
